name: vexview 0.1.0: Modern and Minimalistic Linux Media Viewer and Editor
body:
# vexview 0.1.0

Industrial-grade image and video inspection and editing desktop application for Linux.

### Highlights
- Unified media viewer supporting raster formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF), vector art (SVG), animations (GIF), and videos (MP4, MKV, WebM)
- Distraction-free canvas with smooth zooming, panning, and split comparison
- Non-destructive image adjustments (exposure, contrast, saturation, rotation)
- Lossless video stream trimming without re-encoding
- Native Debian package, portable tarball distribution, and desktop launcher integration
